text:
nina-marketing: hey @ali-runtime quick favorwe're finalizing the launch deck and need a tiny, reproducible bench to justify the embed + rerank numbers.

nina-marketing: ask in one line: run quantized vs baseline FP sweep, provide latency percentiles incl p999, and include one "showcase" prompt pair for slides showing rerank delta. cohort ~150-250.

ali-runtime: ok. which models + quant modes? and do you need recall/ndcg scoring or just latency/throughput?

nina-marketing: prefer rwin-open-7b (fp32), rwin-open-7b-int8, rwin-rex-7b-4bit; but if scheduling tight, just the first two. we want basic NDCG@10 for rerank (strawman labels provided).

sam-devex: tagging needs: campaign=launch-q2, channel=webinar, deck_elem=bench-claim. also please mark spans warmup=true/false and add sample_tag for slide examples.

praveen-eng: timeline check  we can squeeze a smoke run tomorrow morning on staging-gpu; full sweep on Thursday evening. smoke will include single-client traces + 10 tail examples per variant.

nina-marketing: smoke report by Wed 10am would be great so design can iterate. final artifacts Thu EOD. high priority for marketing.

ali-runtime: will queue. payloads link? and do you want the raw request/response pairs in the artifact or scrubbed examples?

nina-marketing: upload to https://files.redwood.local/launch/q2/packA. scrub PII but keep original prompt/context for the slide examples. include a README.txt listing commits, runtime flags, and machine SKU.

bench-bot: Job queued  id=47890, queue=staging-bench, cohort=200, variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8,rwin-rex-7b-4bit], scoring=ndcg@10, tags=[campaign=launch-q2,channel=webinar]. ETA smoke: 2024-06-05T09:00Z.

ali-runtime: command we'll run for reproducibility:
```
run_bench --cohort demo_packA.json
          --models rwin-open-7b-fp32 rwin-open-7b-int8 rwin-rex-7b-4bit
          --warmup 30 --samples 200 --concurrency 8
          --trace-tags "campaign=launch-q2,channel=webinar,deck_elem=bench-claim"
          --scoring ndcg@10 --output artifacts/2154321000-quant-sanity.tar.gz
```

ali-runtime: we'll capture: per-request latency (p50,p90,p95,p99,p999), kernel timings, device util, request headers, and the small subset of prompt/response pairs for slides. we'll keep full logs internal and only export scrubbed artifacts.

praveen-eng: if int8 shows >10% p99 regression vs fp32, we'll snapshot trace + kernel profile and ping infra to hold other jobs. please include a short note in the README about any observed reg flags.

nina-marketing: good. marketing wants at least one human-readable example that shows quality preserved for the quantized variant. capture diff + short comment if rerank order changed.

sam-devex: also please add metric ids to the README (latency_metric_id, ndcg_metric_id) so analytics can wire into dashboards quickly.

bench-bot: Job 47890 started on staging-node-08 at 2024-06-05T08:58:41Z.

ali-runtime: will update thread as smoke completes and when full sweep artifacts are ready. if we hit GPU contention we'll prioritize the 7b-fp32 + 7b-int8 pair and ship that earlier.

nina-marketing: thanks everyone. ping me if anything blocks the Wed smoke. :raised_hands:
